sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, boys and girls! I'm from Beijing and my English name is Judy. Now this term is from September to December. I have many subjects this term. They are math, Chinese, English, history, computer, music, geography, science, art and P.E.. My favourite subjects are English and P.E.. I can talk (谈话) with some students in English now. In the P.E. lesson, I can do many sports. And they are really interesting. I can play soccer and basketball well. And my favourite sport is soccer. Art is very relaxing. I can draw(画) fruit, clothes, desks and many fun things in the art class. Our art teacher is very nice. She always takes us out to draw things.

What subjects do you have this term? What is your favourite subject? Tell me, please. And e-mail me at judy2015@tom.com. You can call me at 309-7708, too.

questions.prompt: 1. Judy's favourite subjects are ________
questions.translation: 朱迪最喜欢的科目是体育和英语。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“My favourite subjects are English and P.E..”可知最喜欢英语和体育。故选 P.E. and English。

questions.prompt: 2. Judy thinks her art class is ________
questions.translation: 朱迪认为她的美术课很让人放松。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Art is very relaxing.”可知美术课很放松。故选 relaxing。

questions.prompt: 3. You can ________ to tell Judy your favourite subject.
questions.translation: 你可以通过发邮件至judy2015@tom.com告诉朱迪你最喜欢的科目。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“And e-mail me at judy2015@tom.com.”可知邮箱地址是judy2015@tom.com。故选 e-mail her at judy2015@tom.com。

questions.prompt: 4. Which can be the best title of this text?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章通篇围绕Judy本学期所学习的各门学科及喜好展开介绍。故选 Judy's Subjects This Term。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
# Tree Climbing Course
The students in the USA started to take tree climbing courses in the 1980s. Now over 1,000 schools offer tree climbing courses to students in the USA.

Xiamen University was the first school in China to teach students to climb trees in 2012. Suzhou No. 1 Junior High School also offers a tree climbing course to students.

# Swimming Course
Starting from 2017, the new students in Tsinghua University need to take a swimming test at the beginning of their university life.

All primary and middle schools in Hainan set up swimming courses in 2019. This year the government is busy building swimming pools for schools at least one for each town, hoping that every student will be able to swim before they leave school.

questions.prompt: 5. There are ________ kinds of courses mentioned in the passage.
questions.translation: 文章中提到了2种课程。
questions.explanation: 文中主要介绍了两门特色课程：Tree Climbing Course 和 Swimming Course。故选 2。

questions.prompt: 6. ________ started the tree climbing course first in China.
questions.translation: 厦门大学在中国最早开设了爬树课程。
questions.explanation: 根据文章“Xiamen University was the first school in China to teach students to climb trees in 2012.”可知是厦门大学。故选 Xiamen University。

questions.prompt: 7. According to the passage, which of the following is True?
options: China started tree climbing courses earlier than the USA.
Hainan will build at least one swimming pool for each town.
Students in Suzhou need to take a swimming test.
Few primary and middle schools in Hainan will set up swimming courses.
questions.translation: 根据文章，下列哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“This year the government is busy building swimming pools for schools at least one for each town...”可知海南每个镇将建至少一个游泳池。故选 Hainan will build at least one swimming pool for each town.。

questions.prompt: 8. The passage is mainly about ________
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲述了什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了中美学校开设爬树、游泳等新兴课程的实践探索。故选 setting up new courses。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
In a school garden in Ningxia, the roles of students are not the same as before. Here students do the teaching.

"This is our vegetable area," a student from Grade 8 tells a visitor. "We have grown many kinds of vegetables."

"Look! These are tomatoes," another student adds, "and those are carrots..."

The two students have been working in the garden since 2021. They are part of their school's gardening program. Actually(事实上), most schools in Ningxia have their own gardens, where students harvest(收获) their special "schoolwork".

In the gardens, students work in teams with the help of their teachers. They finish all the important steps by themselves. For example, team members study what to grow. Then they discuss and plan their gardens. They plant seeds(种子), pull grass and water their plants. Some students also grow oranges and apples by themselves. In autumn, they harvest their "schoolwork"—all kinds of fruits and vegetables!

School gardens provide ideas for classes, too. For example, students study the plants they grow in science classes. Math becomes a tool for planning the garden. Studies have shown that schools' gardening programs help students do better in school.

Schools' gardening programs offer learning experiences as well as fun. Young gardeners can practice skills that are useful for all their lives. They've had fun working together as a team and learned how to work together.

questions.prompt: 9. Who do the teaching in the school garden?
questions.translation: 谁在学校花园里进行讲解教学？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Here students do the teaching.”可知是学生。故选 Students.。

questions.prompt: 10. Students do the following work in the school gardens EXCEPT(除了) ________
options: asking their parents to grow oranges and apples
questions.translation: 学生在学校花园里做以下工作，除了哪一项？
questions.explanation: 根据第五段“Some students also grow oranges and apples by themselves.”可知是学生自己种植，而不是让家长种。故选 asking their parents to grow oranges and apples。

questions.prompt: 11. Which of the following subjects can help students plan the garden?
questions.translation: 下列哪门学科能帮助学生规划花园？
questions.explanation: 根据倒数第二段“Math becomes a tool for planning the garden.”可知是数学。故选 Math。

questions.prompt:
12. From schools' gardening programs, students can ________
①learn how to work together
②practice skills that are useful
③work alone without any help
④get learning experiences and fun
questions.translation: 从学校的园艺项目中，学生们可以获得什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“Young gardeners can practice skills that are useful... had fun working together as a team and learned how to work together... offer learning experiences as well as fun.”可知①②④正确，③错误（学生是团队协作）。故选 ①②④。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 第二节
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Hi! My name is Amy and I'm 12. My father has a toy store. [13] So after school, my mother takes me and my sister Cindy there to help him.

What do Cindy and I do at the store? [14] I watch and make sure nothing breaks. Sometimes I teach kids to play with the new toys. There are always many kids at the store. Some kids just want to look at our toys and play with them. [15] And boys and girls like different toys. [16] but girls like dolls. It's tiring but Cindy and I like going to the store.
wordbank: D. Some kids really want to buy the toys
E. The toy store sells toys at very good prices

questions.translation: 他非常忙碌。
questions.explanation: 后句说“So after school, my mother takes me... to help him.”（因此我们去帮忙），说明爸爸很忙。故选 A项 (He is very busy)。

questions.translation: 辛迪打扫商店。
questions.explanation: 承接问句“What do Cindy and I do at the store?”以及后文作者自己的分工“I watch and make sure...”，前面应交代Cindy的分工。故选 B项 (Cindy cleans the store)。

questions.translation: 有些孩子真想买玩具。
questions.explanation: 与前句“Some kids just want to look at our toys...”形成并列对照。故选 D项 (Some kids really want to buy the toys)。

questions.translation: 男孩喜欢模型汽车……
questions.explanation: 前句提到“And boys and girls like different toys.”，后句为“but girls like dolls”，因此填男孩的喜好。故选 C项 (Boys like model cars)。

sections.title: 五、完形填空
sections.instruction: 二、完形填空 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
2023 is the Year of the Rabbit in China. But [17] would a year be named after a rabbit? Rabbits aren't very strong [18], but they are symbols of beauty and cleverness in Chinese culture. They are also [19] as the luckiest of all the Chinese zodiac(生肖)animals. If you were born in the Year of the Rabbit, you are thought to be beautiful, clever and lucky.

The Chinese zodiac animals [20] more than just what kind of person you are. They also have a deep connection with ancient Chinese culture. Other cultures around the world have their own [21] about rabbits. Most of them think of rabbits as symbols of springtime and cleverness.

People do many things that relate to (与……相关) rabbits. For example, [22] the first day of a new month, people in western countries will say, "Rabbit, rabbit." They believe saying it will bring [23] good luck. [24] not every culture sees rabbits as symbols of good luck. In some cultures, people [25] rabbits to be cheats (骗子)in old tales.

For the most part, rabbits mean good luck, so don't forget to say "rabbit, rabbit" at the beginning of the next [26] month. It could mean 30 days of good luck!

questions.translation: 但为什么一个年份会以兔子命名呢？
questions.explanation: 询问原因用疑问词why。故选 why。

questions.translation: 兔子并不是非常强壮的动物……
questions.explanation: 兔子属于动物，用animals。故选 animals。

questions.translation: 它们也被称为所有中国生肖中最幸运的动物。
questions.explanation: be known as 为固定短语，意为“作为……而闻名/被认为”。故选 known。

questions.translation: 生肖动物所传达的不仅仅是你是什么样的人。
questions.explanation: tell 表示讲述、表达、显露信息。故选 tell。

questions.translation: 世界上的其他文化对兔子也有他们自己的看法。
questions.explanation: ideas about sth. 表示对某事物的观点/看法。故选 ideas。

questions.translation: 例如，在一个新月份的第一天……
questions.explanation: 在具体的某一天用介词on（on the first day）。故选 on。

questions.translation: 他们相信说这个会给他们带来好运。
questions.explanation: 主语为people，对应的宾格代词用them。故选 them。

questions.translation: 然而，并非每种文化都将兔子视为好运的象征。
questions.explanation: 前后文构成转折关系，用副词However。故选 However。

questions.translation: 在一些文化中，人们认为兔子是古老传说中的骗子。
questions.explanation: consider sb./sth. to be... 意为“认为某人/某物是……”。故选 consider。

questions.translation: 在下一个新月份的开始……
questions.explanation: 呼应上文提到的 the first day of a new month，填new。故选 new。

sections.title: 六、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 三、语篇填空 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage: Hi, I'm Tom. I'm [27] middle school student. Today is Monday. I have a busy day today. [28] (one), I have Chinese at 8:30. Then I have history. It's [29] (interest). So it's my favourite subject. The [30] (three) lesson on Monday is math. I don't like it [31] it's boring. After lunch I have a lunch break(午休). I have music [32] the afternoon. Our music teacher is Mrs. Brown. [33] (she) classes are always [34] (relax). After that, I have science. It's difficult [35] interesting. My classes finish at 3:50. After that, I have an art lesson [36] two hours. What a busy day!

questions.prompt: 27. I'm ______ middle school student.
questions.translation: 我是一名中学生。
questions.explanation: 泛指一名中学生，middle以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。故选 a。

questions.prompt: 28. ______ (one), I have Chinese at 8:30.
questions.translation: 首先，我8:30上语文课。
questions.explanation: 列举日程顺序，用序数词First作状语，首字母大写。故选 First。

questions.prompt: 29. It's ______ (interest).
questions.translation: 它很有趣。
questions.explanation: 主语It指代历史学科，作表语用形容词interesting（令人感兴趣的）。故选 interesting。

questions.prompt: 30. The ______ (three) lesson on Monday is math.
questions.translation: 周一的第三节课是数学。
questions.explanation: 定冠词The后接序数词third表示第三节课。故选 third。

questions.prompt: 31. I don't like it ______ it's boring.
questions.translation: 我不喜欢它因为很无聊。
questions.explanation: 引导原因状语从句用because。故选 because。

questions.prompt: 32. I have music ______ the afternoon.
questions.translation: 我下午有音乐课。
questions.explanation: 在下午为固定介词短语 in the afternoon。故选 in。

questions.prompt: 33. ______ (she) classes are always...
questions.translation: 她的课总是……
questions.explanation: 修饰名词classes用形容词性物主代词Her，首字母大写。故选 Her。

questions.prompt: 34. ...classes are always ______ (relax).
questions.translation: ……课总是让人放松的。
questions.explanation: 主语classes指物，表语用形容词relaxing（令人放松的）。故选 relaxing。

questions.prompt: 35. It's difficult ______ interesting.
questions.translation: 它很难但很有趣。
questions.explanation: difficult与interesting构成语义转折，用连词but。故选 but。

questions.prompt: 36. ...have an art lesson ______ two hours.
questions.translation: ……上一节持续两小时的美术课。
questions.explanation: for + 时间段 表示持续一段时间。故选 for。

sections.title: 七、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
Dear Frank,

How are you? I want to talk about some of my subjects with you.

I have Chinese, math and English classes every day. Chinese is useful but it's a little (一点儿) difficult for me. Some students say math is difficult, but I am good at it. English is useful. I have two history classes every week. My history teacher Mr. Wang is great fun. He is my favourite teacher.

My favourite subject is coding(编程). It's about how to make computer programming (程序). It sounds difficult but it's really interesting. This class helps me make computer games. I have the coding classes on Thursday afternoon and Friday morning. Some of my classmates like the lesson, too.

What about your favourite subject?

Eric

questions.prompt: 37. What does Eric think of Chinese?
options: He thinks Chinese is useful but a little difficult.
He thinks Chinese is very boring and easy.
He thinks Chinese is the most relaxing subject.
He thinks Chinese is only for making games.
questions.translation: 埃里克对语文有什么看法？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Chinese is useful but it's a little difficult for me.”可知选A。

questions.prompt: 38. Who is Eric's favourite teacher?
questions.translation: 谁是埃里克最喜欢的老师？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“My history teacher Mr. Wang is great fun. He is my favourite teacher.”可知是Mr. Wang。故选 Mr. Wang.。

questions.prompt: 39. When does Eric have his favourite subject?
options: On Thursday afternoon and Friday morning.
On Monday morning and Wednesday afternoon.
On Tuesday afternoon and Friday afternoon.
questions.translation: 埃里克什么时候上有他最喜欢的科目（编程课）？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“I have the coding classes on Thursday afternoon and Friday morning.”可知选A。

questions.prompt: 40. What is your favourite subject? Why? (30 words or more)
options: My favourite subject is English because it's an interesting language. It's useful, too. I like it and I want to speak English well with my classmates and foreign friends.
I don't have any favourite subject because all subjects at school are too hard for me.
My favourite subject is sleeping at noon because I don't want to attend any classes.
I like staying at home playing games better than going to school.
questions.translation: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？为什么？（30词或更多）
questions.explanation: 选项A观点明确，理由充分，表达符合语法与字数要求。故选A。
